topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I can't believe it's gone. That tree, the one I planted myself, right there by the old fence. It was just a little sapling back then, and now... now there's just this empty space. It was more than just a tree; it was a piece of my childhood, a living memory of all those years we spent watching it grow. It's crazy how something so big, so rooted in the ground, could just vanish like that. I mean, who does something like that? And without a word, without giving it a second thought? It’s like a part of me got torn up with those roots.
